#### Load data
```{r load Seurat object}

# load object with all merged data, not processed
merged <- readRDS("/home/marinani/PhD_Projects/Microglia/Microglia_article/Objects/Co-culture_timecourse/data.microglia_d3_d15_d30_merged.rds")

# load day 58 coculture data
d58_cocul.data <- Read10X("/home/marinani/PhD_Projects/Microglia/Microglia_article/Data/Co-culture_timecourse/Microglia/day58_mg_cocult_filtered_bc_matrix/")

# load day 58 ctrl data
d58_ctrl.data <- Read10X("/home/marinani/PhD_Projects/Microglia/Microglia_article/Data/Co-culture_timecourse/Microglia/day58_mg_ctrl_filtered_bc_matrix/")

```

```{r create objects}

 ############################ day 58 coculture ############################
# create day 58 coculture seurat object
d58_cocul <- CreateSeuratObject(d58_cocul.data, project="coculture", meta.data = data.frame(sample = rep("MG-d58-cocul", ncol(d58_cocul.data)), condition="COCUL", timepoint="D58", row.names = colnames(d58_cocul.data)))

# add demultiplexing data to the metadata
# load the data
demuxlet_cocult_d58 <- read.table("/home/marinani/PhD_Projects/Microglia/Coculture_organoids_04/Analysis_after_demuxltiplexing/coculture_d58/coculture_d58.best", header=T, stringsAsFactors = F, row.names = 1)
# remove the "-1" at the end of each barcode
# rownames(demuxlet_cocult_d58) <- substring(rownames(demuxlet_cocult_d58), 1, 16)
# name each barcode with a singlet, doublet or ambiguous cell type
demuxlet_cocult_d58_best <- setNames(demuxlet_cocult_d58$BEST, rownames(demuxlet_cocult_d58))
# add to the metadata, under the line column
d58_cocul@meta.data$line <- demuxlet_cocult_d58_best[rownames(d58_cocul@meta.data)]
table(d58_cocul@meta.data$line)
sum(is.na(d58_cocul@meta.data$line))
# To rename legend for identity based on cell line:
new.cluster.ids <- setNames(c("Doublet WTC", "Doublet B7", "Singlet B7", "Singlet WTC"), sort(unique(d58_cocul@meta.data$line)))
d58_cocul@meta.data$line <- new.cluster.ids[as.character(d58_cocul@meta.data$line)]
table(d58_cocul$line)
# seem that there are only:
# 2386 doublet WTC, 90 doublet B7, 25 singlet B7, 78 singlet WTC

# normalize and scale
d58_cocul <- NormalizeData(d58_cocul) %>%
  FindVariableFeatures(nfeatures = 3000) %>%
  ScaleData(features=rownames(d58_cocul))
# subset microglia only based on PTPRC positivity and absence of neuron markers (TUBB3 e.g.)
# since I pooled sorted microglia and organoid in the same lane of 10x, even though they were not cocultured,they have aggregated a lot probably, as seen by the high doublet number - this mightb e explained with the ractivity of microglia towards other cells 
d58_cocul_mg <- subset(d58_cocul, subset = PTPRC > 0.5)
d58_cocul_mg <- subset(d58_cocul_mg, subset = TUBB3 > 0 & MAP2 > 1, invert = T)
d58_cocul_mg <- subset(d58_cocul_mg, subset = line == "Doublet WTC", invert = T)

# save
saveRDS(d58_cocul_mg, "/home/marinani/PhD_Projects/Microglia/Microglia_article/Objects/Co-culture_timecourse/day58_mg_cocul.rds")

# subset the rest of the cells as organoid
d58_cocul_org <- subset(d58_cocul, subset = PTPRC > 0 & MRC1 > 0, invert = T)
d58_cocul_org$sample <- "ORG-d58-cocul"
# save
saveRDS(d58_cocul_org, "/home/marinani/PhD_Projects/Microglia/Microglia_article/Objects/Co-culture_timecourse/day58_org_cocul.rds")



 ############################ day 58 control ############################

# create day 58 ctrl seurat object
d58_ctrl <- CreateSeuratObject(d58_ctrl.data, project="coculture", meta.data = data.frame(sample = rep("MG-d58-ctrl", ncol(d58_ctrl.data)), condition="CTRL", timepoint="D58", row.names = colnames(d58_ctrl.data)))

# add demultiplexing data to the metadata
# laod data
demuxlet_ctrl_d58 <- read.table("/home/marinani/PhD_Projects/Microglia/Coculture_organoids_04/Analysis_after_demuxltiplexing/ctrl_d58/ctrl_d58.best", header=T, stringsAsFactors = F, row.names = 1)
demuxlet_ctrl_d58_best <- setNames(demuxlet_ctrl_d58$BEST, rownames(demuxlet_ctrl_d58))
d58_ctrl@meta.data$line <- demuxlet_ctrl_d58_best[rownames(d58_ctrl@meta.data)]
table(d58_ctrl@meta.data$line)
sum(is.na(d58_ctrl@meta.data$line))
new.cluster.ids <- setNames(c("Doublet WTC", "Doublet B7", "Singlet B7", "Singlet WTC"), sort(unique(d58_ctrl@meta.data$line)))
d58_ctrl@meta.data$line <- new.cluster.ids[as.character(d58_ctrl@meta.data$line)]
# seem that there are only:
# 2634 doublet WTC, 676 doublet B7, 272 singlet B7, 45 singlet WTC

# normalize and scale
d58_ctrl <- NormalizeData(d58_ctrl) %>%
  FindVariableFeatures(nfeatures = 3000) %>%
  ScaleData(features=rownames(d58_ctrl)) 
# subset microglia only based on PTPRC positivity and absence of neuron markers (TUBB3 e.g.)
# subset microglia only based on PTPRC positivity and absence of neuron markers (TUBB3 e.g.)
# since I pooled sorted microglia and organoid in the same lane of 10x, even though they were not cocultured,they have aggregated a lot probably, as seen by the high doublet number - this mightb e explained with the ractivity of microglia towards other cells 
d58_ctrl_mg <- subset(d58_ctrl, subset = PTPRC > 0.5)
d58_ctrl_mg <- subset(d58_ctrl_mg, subset = TUBB3 > 0 & MAP2 > 1, invert = T)
d58_ctrl_mg <- subset(d58_ctrl_mg, subset = line == "Doublet WTC", invert = T)

# save
saveRDS(d58_ctrl_mg, "/home/marinani/PhD_Projects/Microglia/Microglia_article/Objects/Co-culture_timecourse/day58_mg_ctrl.rds")

# subset the rest of the cells as organoid
d58_ctrl_org <- subset(d58_ctrl, subset = PTPRC > 0, invert = T)

d58_ctrl_org$sample <- "ORG-d58-ctrl"
```

#### Merge data
```{r merge all data}

Idents(d58_ctrl_mg) <- "sample"
Idents(d58_cocul_mg) <- "sample"
Idents(merged) <- "sample"

merged <- merge(merged, list(d58_cocul_mg, d58_ctrl_mg))
merged <- NormalizeData(merged) %>%
  PercentageFeatureSet("^MT-", col.name = "percent.mt")

```

#### QC and integration
```{r check QC pre-filtering}

# reorder the samples in the metadata to appear in the order desired by us
mg_cocult_levels <- factor(c("MG-d3-ctrl","MG-d15-ctrl","MG-d30-ctrl","MG-d58-ctrl", "MG-d3-cocul","MG-d15-cocul", "MG-d30-cocul","MG-d58-cocul"))
merged$sample <- factor(merged$sample, levels = mg_cocult_levels)
Idents(merged) <- "sample"
# generate color palette based on vintage_cols palette
col_sample <-setNames(c(c("#94D2BD","#58B6AC", "#026D7D", "#002C3D", "#D9BE6D", "#E69000", "#C73E04", "#861D21")), mg_cocult_levels)

pdf("Plots/Co-culture_timecourse/nFeature_pre-QC.pdf", width = 6, height = 5)
VlnPlot(merged, features = c("nFeature_RNA"), cols = col_sample)
dev.off()

pdf("Plots/Co-culture_timecourse/nCount_pre-QC.pdf", width = 6, height = 5)
VlnPlot(merged, features = c("nCount_RNA"), cols = col_sample)
dev.off()

pdf("Plots/Co-culture_timecourse/percent.mt_pre-QC.pdf", width = 6, height = 5)
VlnPlot(merged, features = c("percent.mt"), cols = col_sample)
dev.off()

```

```{r filter cells and filtering}

# subset cells based on QC metrics 
mg_d3_ctrl <- subset(merged, subset = sample == "MG-d3-ctrl" & nFeature_RNA > 2000 & nFeature_RNA < 9000 & nCount_RNA < 90000 & percent.mt < 20)
mg_d15_ctrl <- subset(merged, subset = sample == "MG-d15-ctrl" & nFeature_RNA > 1500 & nFeature_RNA < 8000 & nCount_RNA < 55000 & percent.mt < 20)
mg_d30_ctrl <- subset(merged, subset = sample == "MG-d30-ctrl" & nFeature_RNA > 1000 & nFeature_RNA < 7000 & nCount_RNA < 50000 & percent.mt < 20)
mg_d58_ctrl <- subset(merged, subset = sample == "MG-d58-ctrl" & nFeature_RNA > 2000 & nFeature_RNA < 7000 & nCount_RNA < 50000 & percent.mt < 20)
mg_d3_cocul <- subset(merged, subset = sample == "MG-d3-cocul" & nFeature_RNA > 2000 & nFeature_RNA < 8500 & nCount_RNA < 100000 & percent.mt < 20)
mg_d15_cocul <- subset(merged, subset = sample == "MG-d15-cocul" & nFeature_RNA > 1500 & nFeature_RNA < 7000 & nCount_RNA < 50000 & percent.mt < 20)
mg_d30_cocul <- subset(merged, subset = sample == "MG-d30-cocul" & nFeature_RNA > 1000 & nFeature_RNA < 7000 & nCount_RNA < 50000 & percent.mt < 20)
mg_d58_cocul <- subset(merged, subset = sample == "MG-d58-cocul" & nFeature_RNA > 1000 & nFeature_RNA < 7000 & nCount_RNA < 50000 & percent.mt < 20)

# merge
seurat <- merge(mg_d3_ctrl, list(mg_d15_ctrl, mg_d30_ctrl, mg_d58_ctrl, mg_d3_cocul, mg_d15_cocul, mg_d30_cocul, mg_d58_cocul))

```

```{r check QC post-filtering}

# reorder the samples in the metadata to appear in the order desired by us
Idents(seurat) <- "sample"
mg_cocult_levels <- factor(c("MG-d3-ctrl","MG-d15-ctrl","MG-d30-ctrl","MG-d58-ctrl", "MG-d3-cocul","MG-d15-cocul", "MG-d30-cocul","MG-d58-cocul"))
seurat$sample <- factor(seurat$sample, levels = mg_cocult_levels)

# plot
pdf("Plots/Co-culture_timecourse/nFeature_post-QC.pdf", width = 6, height = 5)
VlnPlot(seurat, features = c("nFeature_RNA"), cols = col_sample)
dev.off()

pdf("Plots/Co-culture_timecourse/nCount_post-QC.pdf", width = 6, height = 5)
VlnPlot(seurat, features = c("nCount_RNA"), cols = col_sample)
dev.off()

pdf("Plots/Co-culture_timecourse/percent.mt_post-QC.pdf", width = 6, height = 5)
VlnPlot(seurat, features = c("percent.mt"), cols = col_sample)
dev.off()

```

```{r pre-process and integrate}

seurat <- NormalizeData(seurat) %>%
  FindVariableFeatures(nfeatures = 3000) %>%
  CellCycleScoring(g2m.features = cc.genes.updated.2019$g2m.genes, s.features = cc.genes.updated.2019$s.genes)
blacklist <- c(unlist(cc.genes.updated.2019), grep("^MT-", rownames(seurat), value=T), read.table("/home/marinani/Scripts/Databases/Gene_lists/RPgenes_bak.txt")[,1])
VariableFeatures(seurat) <- setdiff(VariableFeatures(seurat), blacklist)
seurat <- ScaleData(seurat, vars.to.regress = c("G2M.Score","S.Score", "percent.mt", "nFeature_RNA")) %>%
  RunPCA(npcs = 30, verbose=F) 

library(simspec)
seurat <- cluster_sim_spectrum(seurat, label_tag="sample", cluster_resolution = 1)
seurat <- RunUMAP(seurat, reduction="css", dims=1:ncol(Embeddings(seurat,"css")), reduction.name="umap_css", reduction.key="UMAPCSS_", seed = 46)

seurat <- FindNeighbors(seurat, reduction="css", dims=1:ncol(Embeddings(seurat,"css"))) %>%
  FindClusters(resolution = 0.1) %>%
  FindClusters(resolution = 0.2) %>%
  FindClusters(resolution = 0.3) %>%
  FindClusters(resolution = 0.4) %>%
  FindClusters(resolution = 0.5) %>%
  FindClusters(resolution = 0.6) %>%
  FindClusters(resolution = 0.8) %>%
  FindClusters(resolution = 10)

```


```{r save integrated object}

saveRDS(seurat, "/home/marinani/PhD_Projects/Microglia/Microglia_article/Objects/Co-culture_timecourse/microglia_d3_d15_d30_d58_integrated.rds")
```
